newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Corp named in racketeering suit.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Corp named in racketeering suit.

text.p: Privately-held calling card manufacturer Blackstone Calling Card Inc said on Monday that it had filed a lawsuit seeking $27 million in damages from telecommunications firm Frontier Corp, alleging fraud, racketeering and negligence.

The suit, filed in Circuit Court in Dade County, Florida, alleges that on June 13 Frontier Corp canceled access to network services pre-paid by Blackstone, leaving Blackstone consumers with unusable cards.
Randal Simonetti, a spokeman for Frontier Corp, responded that there was "absolutely no basis for this lawsuit," and that Frontier was in conversations with all involved parties.
